# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c36 P30](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0030), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** The small home of dreams beside the harbour coast  <sub>[v4 c40 P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049)</sub>
- **Titles:** Chieftain (at school)  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; Young Kit  <sub>[v5 c2 P2](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0002)</sub>; Kit  <sub>[v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Kit has curly red hair inherited from his mother, open hazel eyes, a fine nose, and a steady, humorous mouth like his father. He has well-shaped ears that lie flat against his head. He is a solid, dependable-looking young boy.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P16](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0016), [v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)_

## Personality

Kit is a dependable, solid, and straightforward youth who always keeps his promises and prefers personal testing over taking things on trust. He is a leader among his peers at school and enjoys physical activities, brawls, and outdoors pursuits. He possesses a strong curiosity about nature, practical knowledge of his surroundings, and a desire for adventure and military glory.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c7 P31](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0031), [v5 c16 P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)_

## History

Kit was born at the small house of dreams near the harbour, the eldest son of Dr. Carrow and Nell Carrow. Prior to his death, Captain Saul Garrick willed him a collection of unusual curiosities. As a baby, his mother resolved never to use baby talk with him, though she quickly broke her own rule. In his childhood, his family moved from the house of dreams to Hollowmere in the Glen. At the age of eight, he strongly protested being called 'Little Kit', prompting his mother to stop using the nickname around him, though Tabitha continued to do so. Kit grew into a solid, dependable leader among his peers at school, excelling in sports and outdoor activities. He spent much of his youth playing in Fern Hollow, fishing for trout, collecting curiosities in the attic, and gathering wild flowers for his mother. In his early teens, he suggested the creation of a Good-Conduct Club to assist the manse children. At thirteen, Kit stayed after school to study for the entrance examination at Regent's Academy, ultimately departing for Port Marlow to attend the academy.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031), [v4 c36 P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), [v4 c40 P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c3 P10](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0010), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062), [v5 c6 P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 c23 P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
